latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of Copywriter Video Online — Convert Copy Into Videos.

- Instantly converts 150-word product descriptions or sales copy into 1080p MP4 videos in 1–2 minutes
- No manual editing or export settings required; fully AI-driven cloud rendering
- Supports script upload, video generation, status checks, export/download, and credit balance features
- Handles aspect ratio, text/audio tracks, and file uploads automatically via intent recognition
- Designed for copywriters and marketers seeking fast promotional or explainer videos
